Subject: QR scan fails on Coupa mobile — can't complete onboarding

Hi Rachel / Ben,

We're trying to accept the supplier invite but the QR code in the Coupa mobile app shows an error: "Activation code invalid" immediately after scanning. We tried on two Android phones (Pixel 6, Samsung A53) and on iPhone (iOS 15.7) and only the iPhone accepted. The vendor contact (procurement@cardinalsupply.com) is blocked from finishing the bank info step and PO creation is stuck.

Attached: activation_screenshot.png (shows the QR scan error).

Can you confirm whether the QR flow has any device/OS compatibility restrictions? We need this vendor to complete setup before the week closes — they have an urgent PO.

Thanks,

Hi Emily — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot.

Short answer: QR activation should work across platforms; it sounds like a device-specific validation failure. Before I escalate to our infra team, a couple quick asks that will speed troubleshooting:
- Can you attach a redacted bank statement (last 4 digits only) or W-9 so we can attempt a manual verification?
- Can you confirm which Coupa app version was used on the Pixel and Samsung? (Settings > About)
- If possible, please try the QR on a desktop (Coupa displays an "Activate on this device" link under the QR) and paste the browser user-agent string when you do.

We'll triage with Ben immediately if the vendor cannot complete the PO. If you prefer, we can enable a temporary desktop-only activation for Cardinal Supply to close this PO today.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Manager, Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QR scan fails on Coupa mobile — can't complete onboarding

Adding some technical context from infra: we've seen a validation mismatch when the QR payload includes an encoded timestamp older than the device clock by more than 5 minutes; some Android devices (older vendor OEM stacks) report clock drift in scanned camera frames. That can produce the "Activation code invalid" message even though the code itself is correct.

Immediate options:
1) Ask vendor to confirm device clock / timezone and retry.
2) Enable a one-off server-side leniency for Cardinal Supply: increase QR timestamp tolerance to +/- 10 minutes for that invite. We have a small change and a safe guard (only for single invite token) — tracked in SERV-1342.
3) Provide a desktop activation link (manual fallback).

I can push the leniency change if you authorize it; it takes ~30 minutes to roll and we'd revoke it after activation.

Ben Carter
Senior Engineer, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference

Hi Emily — looping back with a clear next step so we can close your PO today.

Workaround (recommended):
- Please use the desktop activation link instead of the mobile QR. Open the invite email on a laptop and click the "Activate" link — that bypasses the mobile camera QR entirely.
- Attach one of the following to this thread so we can manually verify: redacted bank statement (PDF) or W-9. You can upload directly here or use the DocuSign link if you prefer: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123

If the vendor would like us to enable the temporary QR tolerance change (Ben mentioned SERV-1342), we can do that as a fallback while they retry on their phones. Let me know if you want us to flip that on — otherwise please try the desktop path and attach the redacted bank file.

I'll monitor until the cardless PO is created and confirm when the vendor shows active in Coupa.

Thanks for the quick coordination — apologies for the friction, we should have this closed within a day.

Regards,
